name: @olai/web
//exports: The build script produces browser assets; there is no application root export. ./client/* contains shared utilities, and ./testlib exposes only their stable testing contracts. Feature consumers use their owning plugin contracts, not a catalogue maintained here.
//child: @olai/child is the subprocess socket src/build.ts rides for the Tailwind CLI. The browser bundle must never import it — this is a build-script dependency, the same carve-out `node:child_process` was.
//dependencies: Runtime dependencies support browser composition and shared rendering. The child-process dependency is build-only for Tailwind; Babel and Tailwind tooling never enter the browser graph. Feature dependencies belong in their owning plugin packages.
//tailwind: TWO entries, and the second is not redundant. @tailwindcss/cli is the binary src/build.ts spawns. `tailwindcss` is what `@import "tailwindcss"` inside src/client/styles.css resolves — and under the isolated linker (bunfig.toml) a transitive dependency of the CLI is nested where nothing outside it can see, so the CLI fails with "Can't resolve 'tailwindcss'" until this package declares it directly. Hoisted trees (srid/drishti) never notice; this one does.
//boundary: Browser boot and reusable rendering utilities. Feature implementations, contracts and test IDs live with their owners; this general package imports no plugin. The bundle supplies selected rows and assets. See README.md and the bundle boundary tests.
